description: Minimal SvelteKit app with the static adapter (SSG), obfuscated via @afterpack/sveltekit (over @afterpack/vite). @afterpack runs on Vite's closeBundle, so the client bundle is obfuscated before the static adapter copies it into build/. Proves a prerendered SvelteKit page hydrates + the counter interaction works in chromium with the obfuscated client.

build.note: vite build (via SvelteKit) obfuscates the client bundle on closeBundle; adapter-static copies it into build/. version.name pinned in svelte.config.js for determinism.

interactions.description: The obfuscated client hydrates the prerendered page; the counter increments on click.
